# 1 Enoch Chapter 19 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Watchers

---

**19:1** And Uriel said to me: "Here shall stand the angels who consorted with women. Their spirits, taking on many forms, have been defiling humanity and leading them astray into offering sacrifices to demons as to gods — and they shall remain here until the great day of judgment, at which time they shall be judged and brought to an end."

**19:2** "And the wives of those wayward angels shall become sirens."

**19:3** And I, Enoch, alone saw the vision — the ends of all things — and no man has seen what I have seen.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering adjudicated from EMET (literal), LOGOS (formal), and PNEUMA (dynamic). Where the three converge, the shared rendering is adopted. Where they diverge, SOPHIA selects the rendering that best preserves accuracy while remaining accessible, with divergences logged in the disagreement file.*
